messages:
Rae: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we sketched missing tests/evals that blocked root-cause verification; need owners and timelines.
Jordan: Sharing the list now. Can we flag anything that must block a rollout if it regresses?
Rae: Yes. Heuristic: customer-impacting prompts first, then low-effort coverage gaps.
Rae: Candidate items: 1) prompt-set for resume/fallback edge prompts 2) KV-eviction × long-context regression 3) burst load test for small-batch high-concurrency 4) short chaos drill simulating intermittent shard restarts 5) integration test for prefix/KV cache warm-start after failover.
Aisha: I can own KV-eviction regression (item 2). Est: 3d to author cases + 2d to automate in the regression runner. Target 2024-07-05.
Jordan: I'll own the prompt-set (1). Need ~30 examples + scoring harness. Target 2024-06-28.
Tom: I can run the chaos drill (4). Will coordinate with Eng-SRE for a safe window; propose a 1h drill on staging. Target 2024-07-12.
Priya: For the load test (3) — I'll parameterize existing harness with a "burst" config and a template. Target 2024-07-01.
Rae: Who can lead the cache warm-start integration test (5)? It needs infra knowledge.
Tom: I can handle infra wiring, but pair with Aisha on KV specifics. Proposal: Aisha lead + Tom infra. Target 2024-07-08.
Jordan: Outline doc pushed: https://redwood.internal/docs/pm/postmortem-543 — has traces to seed prompt-set.
Aisha: Adding vectors from traces. Will include flaky-case guards so CI doesn't flake on timing.
Rae: Action items recap:
  - A1: Prompt-set + scoring harness — owner: Jordan — due: 2024-06-28 — PR + eval outputs.
  - A2: KV-eviction regression + automation — owner: Aisha — due: 2024-07-05 — include eviction fixture.
  - A3: Burst load template — owner: Priya — due: 2024-07-01 — add to perf harness.
  - A4: Chaos drill runbook + staging run — owner: Tom — due: 2024-07-12 — coordinate with SRE.
  - A5: Cache warm-start integration test — owners: Aisha (lead) + Tom (infra) — due: 2024-07-08.
Jordan: I'll open the prompt-set PR today and tag reviewers.
Priya: I'll draft the load template + small runbook for perf-ci.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window requested for staging: 2024-07-11T02:00-03:00 UTC. React :thumbsup: to approve.
Tom: Noted — will avoid scheduling the chaos drill during that window.
Rae: Suggestion: add regression gating for critical prompts. If eval drop >5% on critical prompt, block rollout and auto-open remediation ticket.
Jordan: Agree — we can wire eval alerts into the rollout pipeline; I'll draft a short RFC.
Priya: For load tests, log the request-level metrics from the incident (tail latency, queue length) so we can correlate with eval drops.
Aisha: Question — recorded traces or synthetic for prompt-set? Recorded gives realistic edge cases.
Jordan: Recorded + anonymized as base, augment synthetically for coverage.
Rae: Owners, add these AIs to the postmortem board and tag "remediation" and "evals". I'll do a 1:1 review next Tue.
onchalant reaction: :eyes: (emoji).
onchalant: Keep tests short to avoid blowing up CI runtime: unit-level first, full regression on schedule.
oncall-bot: Reminder: follow-up review meeting 2024-06-25 15:00 UTC — attendees: Rae, Jordan, Aisha, Priya, Tom.
Aisha: Updating the board and adding PR links.
Jordan: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/evals/pull/412 — prompt-set draft. Reviewers: Rae, Priya.
Priya: PR opened for load harness template: https://git.redwood/repo/perf/pull/88 — includes burst config.
Tom: Added chaos runbook draft: https://git.redwood/playbooks/chaos/kv-shard-restart.md — requested Eng-SRE review.
Rae: Thanks all. If anything slips, ping me. Will escalate to Eng-Platform if infra approvals block. :thumbsup:
